This time, according to The Information's reporting as picked up by Electrek and Carscoops, Tesla is preparing to show the long-delayed sports car briefly lifting off the ground with SpaceX cold gas thrusters at a Texas test site. The target is August 2026 or later. That's close enough to matter.
